The Stop hook keeps the HANDOVER MANIFEST current on GitHub without anyone remembering to.
It runs 99_OPS/sync_handover.py at the end of each turn: that script commits and pushes ONLY
the skill, the explainer docs, the frozen spec, the finished score/fund/ISIN data and the
command-centre state files. It is a no-op when none of those changed, so ordinary coding turns
cost nothing. Source code is deliberately NOT auto-synced -- an auto-commit of every dirty file
would push half-written code the moment a turn ended.
It exists because on 2026-08-13 the skill was handed over after a long editing session and the
recipient's clone saw none of the material: the default branch is a 1-file stub with an
